scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.dev: bun run build.ts && bun run serve
scripts.lint: bunx tsc && bunx @biomejs/biome lint . && bun run lint:markdown && bun run lint:skills
scripts.lint:markdown: markdownlint-cli2 && cspell lint --no-progress && bun run lint:words
scripts.lint:words: sed -e '/^#/d' -e 's/ *#.*//' -e '/^$/d' project-words.txt | LC_ALL=C sort -c -f -u || { echo 'project-words.txt: keep words sorted (case-insensitive) and unique' >&2; exit 1; }
